recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, atmospheric composition featuring a vast, deep red and magenta sky transitioning into dark, smoky clouds at the bottom. A low, curved horizon line suggests a planetary surface, while the top edge contains stylized, metallic-effect typography and a secondary title in a bold, slanted sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant red sky dominates the upper two-thirds of the frame
Dark, textured planetary surface anchors the bottom edge
Highly stylized custom lettering in the top-left corner contrasts with the clean title in the top-right
Soft, airbrushed transitions between magenta, orange, and deep red tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sky is the primary subject, occupying 85% of the frame. The horizon is pushed to the extreme bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-left custom lettering acts as the primary visual anchor due to its size and complexity.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left lettering, move across the top-right title, and then descend through the red gradient to the dark horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The central red area functions as active negative space, creating a sense of scale and heat.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and Gold (Typography and Horizon Highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the upper regions with a value shift from bright red to near-black at the bottom.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm spectrum: Red, Orange, Magenta, Gold

letterConstructionRules: Top-left: Interlocking, overlapping glyphs with thick outlines and internal gradients
Top-right: Heavy, italicized, wide-tracked sans-serif with sharp corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely elongated descenders and ascenders that wrap around other letters
Metallic beveling effects on the main logo-like text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex, illustrative logo paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for balance.
graphicDevices: Thin white border framing the entire image

preserve: Overlapping nature of the primary logo
Wide tracking for the secondary title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, slanted, 80s tech-feel of the secondary title
The primary logo is too unique for a standard font; requires manual pathing

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed 1980s style landscape with a vast crimson and magenta sky. The bottom 15% should be a dark, textured planetary surface with wispy, smoky clouds rising from the horizon. The overall mood is hot and atmospheric.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, custom-lettered interlocking logo in the top-left corner with a gold-to-red gradient and thick outline. In the top-right, add a single line of text in a bold, italicized, wide-tracked yellow sans-serif. Frame the entire piece with a thin white border.

verificationChecks: Is the horizon line low enough?
Is the sky a vibrant gradient of red and magenta?
Is the secondary text wide-tracked and italicized?
Does the primary logo have an overlapping, illustrative quality?

adjustableVariables: Amount of smoke/cloud detail at the horizon
mustRedesign: Specific band name and album title wording
Unique interlocking ligatures of the original logo
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth color transitions in the sky
Ensure the horizon looks like a planetary surface, not just a line
Verify the text is placed in the top corners only
Confirm the presence of the thin white border
recipe.reuseFormula: Atmospheric Red Sky + Low Horizon + Top-Corner Typography + Airbrush Texture
